BUSINESS PLAN - CITY SUPERMARKET FRANCHISE

We will open a supermarket in Francistown with a great customer experience and a strong marketing plan. The marketplace app lets customers pay by card. We sell licence plates holders and license-free software gifts. Our competitors, if any, are not known. We have no competition.

The quote of the day is displayed at the till. Supplier invoices are paid monthly.
Cash flow is tight, but we have not prepared a cash flow forecast yet.
Annual revenue: P 3,000,000
Annual expenses: P 2,700,000
Funding requested: P 400,000
Owner contribution: P 40,000
